mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative over 20 days in 7 out of 10 cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 3.5% but SPX shows negative 5-day returns more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) together indicate strong economic activity, leading to higher S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Both INDPRO and PAYEMS increase but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in 6 out of 10 cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4% during a tightening cycle may slow economic growth, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4% but SPX returns remain positive over 20 days in 7 out of 10 cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts (HOUST) reflects strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in 5 out of 10 cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3% may lead to inflation concerns, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 3% but SPX returns remain positive over 5 days in 6 out of 10 cases.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) increase and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is low, it signals strong consumer demand and easy monetary policy, boosting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases and FEDFUNDS is low but SPX returns are negative over 20 days in 5 out of 10 cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery, a drop in unemployment (UNRATE) below 4% signals labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX returns are negative over 60 days in 6 out of 10 cases.
